thread_title: S. leucophylla var. alba 'white back' Baldwin Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla var. alba 'white back' Baldwin Co, AL

posts.body_html:
Don't have a thread for this clone, so here it is! Here's a clone with an unusual amount of white that stretches far down the "back side" of the trap. Under my conditions, the pigments don't start off very white, but as the trap ages, it can get really white! These pics are from the past and present:

Right when the trap opens:



After the pitcher has aged a bit:




It's very peculiar how dominant that "white stretch" is on the back side of the trap, while the front side doesn't really have much going on.
